'''Hoom Garaf''' was a [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] who was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which took place from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. During the [[Third Battle of Aefao]], he was [[Death/Legends|executed]] by [[Hoom Garaf's T-series tactical droid|his]] [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] during a disagreement. The resulting [[Lightfight|firefight]] in the Separatist rear guard allowed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to achieve victory at<ref name="Warfare" /> the [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> [[Aefao]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hoom Garaf was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference book penned by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
